account.avatarLead: Pick one of the presets. The default is the first letter of your username.
account.passwordLead: The new password must be at least 8 characters and different from the current one. Saving signs out other devices. This device stays signed in.
account.usernameRule: Use 2 to 32 characters: Chinese, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
account.usernameOnce: You can change your username only once. After that, log in with the new username.
account.passwordRequired: Enter the current password and a new password
account.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
account.passwordSame: The new password must be different from the current password

settings.firstUseBody: Add your own provider, API base URL, and key, then choose a model for each task before you can generate chapter one. Keys are encrypted on the server by default and are not included in a book export. You can also keep a key only in this browser.
settings.localNote: The key stays only in this browser. You will need to enter it again after switching browsers, switching devices, or clearing site data. Calls are still relayed by this server to the model provider, but the key is not saved there.
settings.arkNoteBefore: Volcengine Ark does not load a model list. Open the
settings.arkNoteAfter: and copy a Model ID into the field on the right.
settings.modelsReady: Loaded {count} model. Pick one on the right. | Loaded {count} models. Pick one on the right.
settings.modelsTruncated: The list is long, so only the first 500 are shown. You can also type a model id.
settings.noProvidersAdd: No providers yet. Add one from the top right.
settings.keysHelp: OpenAI-compatible APIs are supported. The Volcengine Ark base URL is https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3. Test checks the base URL and the key. If a model id is set, that id is tried once as well. A key saved on the server is stored encrypted and still works on another device. A key kept only on this device is not stored on the server, so a different browser or device needs it again. Either way, calls are relayed by this server to the model provider.

hints.assist: Discuss the outline, chapter plan, and characters

settings.searchModels: Choose or search for a model
settings.taskHelpBefore: Providers such as OpenRouter load a model list you can search and choose from. For Volcengine Ark, open the
settings.taskHelpAfter: and copy a Model ID. The provider bills model usage.
settings.exportHelp: Export the whole book: chapters as Markdown, and character cards, setup, foreshadows, summaries, and the outline as YAML, packed in a zip.
settings.toLocalBody: The key will stay only in this browser. Any key already on the server will be cleared and cannot be moved over automatically, so you need to enter it again. Switching browsers, switching devices, or clearing site data also means entering it again. When you call a model, the key is still sent to this site and relayed to the provider, but it is not written to the database.
settings.toServerBody: The key will be encrypted and stored on the server. After a successful save, the copy in this browser is deleted. You can use it after signing in on another device.
settings.deletePrompt: Deleting this book also deletes the chapters, memory library, foreshadows, and version history. This cannot be undone. Type the title “{title}” to confirm.
